valuation.valuation_commentary: Valuation synthesis for MU indicates clear overvaluation relative to intrinsic cash flow generation capacity. The primary anchor is the through-cycle DCF (effective weight 100%), yielding a fair value of .13 against the current market price of .33 (-21.78% premium to intrinsic value). Corroborating intrinsic frameworks such as the Buffett Owner Earnings multiple indicate a fair value of .50, reinforcing that normalized long-term cash flows do not justify current market levels. While sell-side consensus maintains an aggressive price target of ,468.26, this relies on peak-cycle margin and revenue extrapolation during the AI/HBM paradigm shift. Under the paradigm-only transition signature, our fundamental DCF anchor exercises disciplined cycle normalization, triggering an overvalued verdict and a score of -1.0.
